content_descriptors.notes:
Ajgal Demo contains strong psychological horror themes.
It features scenes of symbolic violence, psychological distress, and unsettling ritualistic imagery.
The story explores guilt, abandonment, and emotional trauma through a metaphorical, organic world.

name: Ajgal Demo
